metric_definitions.start_to_first_render_ms: performance(first non-silent AudioWorklet notification received on main thread) minus performance(media start). Includes message dispatch; boundary probe, not acoustic first sound or a full model turn.
metric_definitions.connect_ms: Signaling, connection establishment and player preparation, including 80ms warmup; not pure handshake latency.
metric_definitions.source_pause: Source supply pauses for 200ms after 50 × 20ms frames; no network packet loss injection.
metric_definitions.ws_underrun_ms: Worklet empty-queue samples after playback starts and before expected source consumption / 48 samples per ms.
metric_definitions.rtc_delta: Matched inbound-rtp end minus start counters. Missing field or missing start stream => null; never assume zero.
metric_definitions.jitter_buffer_mean_delay_ms: 1000 × delta(jitterBufferDelay seconds) / delta(jitterBufferEmittedCount); missing or zero denominator => null.
metric_definitions.packet_loss_fraction: delta(packetsLost) / (delta(packetsReceived) + delta(packetsLost)); missing/zero denominator => null. Signed lost-counter corrections are retained.
metric_definitions.rtc_end_snapshot: Diagnostic cumulative end values, not an interval delta and not comparable to WS empty-queue duration.
metric_definitions.rtc_complete: End-probe detection plus >=250ms guard AND client receives DataChannel producer_done; no bit-exact source sample ACK.
metric_definitions.probe_plausibility: AudioContext frames used only for end-probe diagnostics. Expected offset = fixture samples/rate minus 300ms tail + optional 200ms pause; tolerance ±250ms. A plausibility screen, not proof against all false positives.
metric_definitions.rtc_tail: 300ms canonical zero tail versus 250ms guard may finish roughly 50ms before canonical tail end; codec time scaling and block alignment also affect timing.
metric_definitions.ws_complete: received_samples == worklet consumed == fixture.samples; no acoustic loopback.

ws.note: Two fixed fixtures × three repeated runs; six observations, not six independent fixtures.

rtc.note: Two fixed fixtures × three repeated runs; six observations, not six independent fixtures.

sessions.scope: Python synthetic control and session state transitions; not real audio rendering.

browser_drain.scope: Same-browser performance clock: producer_done observed → worklet finished notification; includes message dispatch.

remote_connectivity.scope: Remote connectivity only: WS via SSH forwarding; not a fair speed comparison with local UDP.

exclusions.pilot_and_failed_starts: No globbing or directory merging; only the named v2 final input.
exclusions.browser_formal_v1: Diagnostic only: full RTC source supply but two source_pause/short client producer_done controls missing before close. Excluded from all final p50 values.

data_issues.effect: RTC interval counters and derived delay/loss ratios stay null. End snapshots are separately labeled diagnostics.
